test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Parts of the following sentence are given as options. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

Scarcely had the train stopped at the platform than the passengers started pushing each other to enter the train.
solution: The correct answer is **'than the passengers'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is grammatically incorrect. • Here,** 'when the passengers'** should be used instead of **'than the passengers'.** • We know that '**Scarcely/ Hardly**' is followed by '**when**'. • *Example: Lena had **scarcely **gotten through the door **when** the phone rang.* • Thus, the erroneous part is **'than the passengers'.** **Correct Sentence:__** *Scarcely had the train stopped at the platform **when the passengers **started pushing each other to enter the train.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है। • यहां **'than the passengers' **के बजाय **'when the passengers'** का इस्तेमाल किया जाना चाहिए। • हम जानते हैं कि 'Scarcely/ Hardly' के बाद '**when**' आता है। • *Example: Lena had **scarcely** got through the door **when** the phone rang.* • इस प्रकार, गलत हिस्सा **'than the passengers'** है। cc:Ta7a, The correct answer is '**BACD**'.
